{{Quote|I'm not even remotely concerned with what happened to Officer Voystock—or who was ultimately responsible for him getting exactly what was coming to him. By all accounts, he was as lazy as he was stupid, and he died in the process of aiding and abetting an ultimately unsuccessful escape attempt. None of which is particularly unusual around here, except that he went about it with remarkable clumsiness and incompetence. Whatever fate befell him, I'm sure he deserved it. He will not be missed.|[[Warden/Legends|Warden]] [[Sadiki Blirr]], following Voystock's death|<ref name="Lock" />}}
'''Voystock''' was one of the guards of the [[Cog Hive Seven]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] the same year at the same place by [[Darth Maul/Legends|Jagannath]]. Before his death, he had a deal with the inmate [[Artagan Truax]] to get him and his son [[Eogan Truax|Eogan]] out of the prison. During the escape attempt, he attempted to betray the Truax's, leading to his death by Maul's hands in the prison medbay.
